reply_text:
For Linden, I couldn't find a main contact or a deadline. I checked every channel you're in (#central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api), our DM and the shared files you can open, and none of them mention Linden. I won't guess. The account owner or the CRM entry should have both.

**West yard Door 2 double-booking:** the ticket is **#8841**. Tobias opened it on 13 Oct in #central-random. He said Door 2 still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He was answering your question about "Tobias's dealer account," so the message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I'm taking it to be that account because the 2 Jan Central handoffs digest lists Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account that changed hands on 5 Jan. That digest doesn't say who took it over, so check with Tobias before it goes into the handover.
